subject: Security walkthrough — SOC 2 + pen test + DPA: availability & preflight asks
body:
From: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@finpay.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Security walkthrough: SOC 2 + pen test + DPA review (availability)

Hi Rafael,

We'd like to get a combined security/compliance walkthrough covering three items: a SOC 2 orientation for our security team, a pen-test scoping conversation, and a quick DPA review for legal. Target audience: security engineering (2), product security (1), legal (1).

High-level constraints from our side:
- Pen-test vendor can only run in 2-hour contiguous windows and prefers pre-windows sync with your ops
- Legal needs the DPA redline file a few days in advance for review
- Prefer mornings PT (9–11am PT) or afternoons CET (15–17 CET) next week (Aug 8–12)

Can you share availability and any preflight docs we should gather? Also let us know if any of these items need separate sessions.

Thanks,
Alex Ramos
Senior Security Ops
FinPay, Inc.
security@finpay.com

---
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@finpay.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Aug 2028 10:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security walkthrough: SOC 2 + pen test + DPA review (availability)

Hi Alex — thanks for the clear constraints.

Short answer: we can do a single 90–120 minute combined session if you want a compact run-through, or split into two sessions (SOC2 + DPA in a 60m call, pen-test scoping separate 60–90m due to vendor ops). Given the pen-test vendor constraint, folks often do: 45m SOC2 orientation + 15m buffer, and a separate 90m vendor scoping block.

Preflight items we usually request (attached checklist):
- SOC2: list of in-scope systems, key contacts, and one sample control evidence (syslog, config extract)
- Pen-test: high-level asset inventory and acceptance criteria; vendor contact + preferred attack window
- DPA: your legal redlines (Word) or pointer to a DocuSign/contract repo

Proposed slots (all in your preferred morning PT / afternoon CET windows):
- Tue Aug 8: 09:30–11:00 PT (16:30–18:00 CET) — combined 90m
- Wed Aug 9: 09:00–11:00 PT (16:00–18:00 CET) — two-blocks (SOC2 quick + vendor scoping)
- Fri Aug 11: 10:00–11:30 PT (19:00–20:30 CET) — if you need later in the week

I attached our redwood_preflight_checklist.pdf and a short SOC2-evidence-request.xlsx to help your team prepare.

If you confirm a slot, we'll send a calendar invite with a run-of-show and an ops bridge.

Cheers,
Rafael Mendes
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
phone: +1 415-555-0198

Attachments: redwood_preflight_checklist.pdf (application/pdf); SOC2-evidence-request.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

---
From: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@finpay.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: security@finpay.com
Date: Mon, 6 Aug 2028 11:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Security walkthrough: SOC 2 + pen test + DPA review (availability)

Rafael — thanks, that helps. Our team prefers Wed Aug 9 in the two-block flow (SOC2 quick + vendor scoping) so we can have the vendor on the line for the second block.

Confirmed attendees: Maya Patel (Product Security), Joe Kline (Security Eng), Priya Narang (Legal). Vendor contact will be pentest@attacklab.io (Sam Park).

A couple of quick notes:
- We'll upload the DPA redline to the DocuSign link you provided by EOD Tue Aug 7
- Vendor requires a 30-minute pre-call with ops for handshake; can your ops join 30 minutes before the pen-test block?

We can take Wed Aug 9 09:00–11:00 PT. Please send the invite.

Thanks — Alex

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@finpay.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Aug 2028 08:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Calendar invite & run-of-show for Wed Aug 9 walkthrough

Alex / team — putting the invite on the calendar for Wed, Aug 9, 2028 09:00–11:00 PT and adding a 30m ops handshake at 08:30 PT for the vendor.

Run of show (proposed):
- 08:30–09:00 PT: Ops handshake with pentest vendor (Sam Park, AttackLab)
- 09:00–09:45 PT: SOC 2 orientation (controls mapping, evidence queue)
- 09:45–10:00 PT: Quick break / buffer
- 10:00–11:00 PT: Pen-test scoping with vendor (scope, exclusions, expected test windows)

Invite includes: calendar-invite-20280809.ics, ops bridge link, and a link to the shared Drive folder for evidence. Please review the preflight checklist attached.

If legal needs the DPA redlines in a specific format, reply-all and we'll make sure the right person (Marissa) pulls the correct template.

Best,
Priyom Das
Customer Success — Security Programs
Redwood Inference
